test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not a voice assistant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carvaan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• A Voice Assistant is an intelligent personal assistant or a connected speaker, is a new type of product marketed by Apple, Amazon and Google and is based on natural language speech recognition.
 
• **Cortana **is a virtual assistant developed by Microsoft, which uses the Bing search engine to perform tasks such as setting reminders and answering questions for the user.
 
• **Alexa **is a voice-controlled virtual assistant.
 
 
• She can play audio, control your smart home, answer questions and engage your favourite services to keep you organized, informed, safe, connected and entertained. 
 
 
 
• **Siri **is an intelligent assistant that offers a faster, easier way to get things done on your Apple devices. 
 
• **Caravaan **is a music player.
 
• **Hence Carvaan is the correct answer.**
